entries.label: doppler-watch and pstack-watch workflow unit tests
engineering skills, CI Python tests, lychee skills, book links, and statechart TS checks
command: set -euo pipefail; uv run --with-requirements scripts/ci-requirements.txt python3 scripts/check_engineering_skills.py; uv run --with-requirements scripts/ci-requirements.txt python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_ci_*.py" -v; lychee --offline --no-progress --include-fragments --root-dir "$PWD" ".agents/skills/**/*.md"; bash scripts/check-book-links.sh; node --check .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.ts .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/janitor.ts .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/kill.ts .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/run.ts .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/backends/mermaid.ts .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/frontends/dot.ts; set +e; node .agents/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.ts; code=$?; set -e; test $code -eq 0 -o $code -eq 2

entries.reason: Hosted GitHub Actions execution of pstack-watch.yml (schedule/workflow_dispatch 403 fallback issue lifecycle and remote branch cleanup) runs on GitHub Actions
